findings.title: Submitted backlog can exceed the configured running-compaction bound
findings.summary: After the RR-001 repair aligned family 1 with the confirmed duplicate-L0 scenario, the overlap artifact disappeared and both affected hunt reruns instead reached `BoundedRunningClaims`. In the family-5 rerun, the coordinator promotes two valid `Submitted` jobs to `Scheduled` and the worker then claims both while `MaxConcurrent = 1`; the family-1 rerun reaches the same bound violation after a local plus remote submission sequence. The resulting candidate matches the modeling brief's fragmented-capacity family rather than the consumed family-1 artifact. The next confirmation pass should check whether this running-bound counterexample is a real implementation bug or another fidelity gap.
